attributes.cardDescription: A comprehensive test of different card types at various sizes to evaluate height thresholds

content.content:
# Embedded Card Size & Height Test

This document demonstrates how different card types behave at various size presets. Use this to evaluate the proposed height thresholds:

| Size | Width | Max Height | Scroll Threshold |
|------|-------|------------|------------------|
| small | 320px | 200px | Auto-scroll |
| medium | 480px | 320px | Auto-scroll |
| large | 640px | 450px | Auto-scroll |
| full | 100% | none | Natural flow |

---

## 1. Quote Cards (Short Content)

Quotes are typically short and should fit naturally at any size.

### Small Quote

::card{id=0 format=embedded size=small}

### Medium Quote

::card{id=0 format=embedded size=medium}

### Long Quote (should test scroll threshold)

::card{id=1 format=embedded size=small}

At medium width:

::card{id=1 format=embedded size=medium}

---

## 2. Code Snippets (Variable Height)

Code can range from a few lines to hundreds.

### Short Code at Small Size

::card{id=2 format=embedded size=small}

### Longer Code at Medium Size

::card{id=3 format=embedded size=medium}

### Same Code at Full Width

::card{id=3 format=embedded size=full}

---

## 3. Email (Long Content)

Emails are often long and benefit from scroll or expand.

### Short Email at Medium Size

::card{id=4 format=embedded size=medium}

### Long Email at Medium Size (should scroll)

::card{id=5 format=embedded size=medium}

### Long Email at Full Width

::card{id=5 format=embedded size=full}

---

## 4. Receipt (Narrow & Long)

Receipts are naturally narrow. Small size works well.

### Short Receipt at Small Size

::card{id=6 format=embedded size=small}

### Long Receipt at Small Size (should scroll)

::card{id=7 format=embedded size=small}

### Long Receipt at Medium Size

::card{id=7 format=embedded size=medium}

---

## 5. Product Cards (Medium Height)

Product cards are typically medium-sized with images.

### Product at Small Size

::card{id=8 format=embedded size=small}

### Product at Medium Size (sweet spot)

::card{id=8 format=embedded size=medium}

### Product at Large Size

::card{id=9 format=embedded size=large}

---

## 6. Video (Aspect Ratio)

Videos should maintain 16:9 aspect ratio.

### Video at Small Size

::card{id=10 format=embedded size=small}

### Video at Medium Size

::card{id=10 format=embedded size=medium}

### Video at Full Width

::card{id=11 format=embedded size=full}

---

## 7. Person Cards (Compact)

Person cards from the original test.

### Person at Small Size

::card{id=12 format=embedded size=small}

### Person at Medium Size

::card{id=12 format=embedded size=medium}

---

## 8. Fitted Format Comparison

Fitted format uses explicit pixel dimensions with container queries.

### Small Fitted (200x200)

::card{id=12 format=fitted width=200 height=200}

### Medium Fitted (300x300)

::card{id=12 format=fitted width=300 height=300}

### Wide Fitted (400x150)

::card{id=12 format=fitted width=400 height=150}

---

## Summary

This test helps visualize:
1. Which content types naturally fit within size thresholds
2. When scrolling should kick in
3. How different card designs adapt to width constraints
4. The difference between embedded (responsive) and fitted (fixed) formats
